intro.text: The Bloomwilds has fallen asleep. Together with your little Spark, you can wake the world up — one place at a time.
intro.simple: Hi! The world is asleep. Help wake it up.

challengeIntro.letter-match.text: Listen to the sound and bring the letter to the tree.
challengeIntro.letter-match.simple: Bring the letter to the tree.

challengeIntro.word-build.text: Build the word letter by letter.

challengeIntro.phonics-pop.text: Pop the leaves that start with the right sound.

challengeIntro.count-lilies.text: Count the lilies out loud if you'd like, then tap the right number.

challengeIntro.frog-jump-add.text: The frog hops a few lilies at a time. Add them up and pick the answer.

challengeIntro.habitat-sort.text: Where does the critter live? Sort them home.

challengeIntro.lifecycle-order.text: Put the butterfly's life in order, from tiny to tall.

challengeIntro.critter-call.text: Which sound does each animal make?

challengeIntro.pattern-finish.text: Look at the pattern and pick what comes next.

challengeIntro.shape-sort.text: Sort the shapes into two piles.

challengeIntro.color-mix.text: Mixing colors makes new ones. Which one do you get?

challengeIntro.name-the-feeling.text: What does the cloud feel? Match the face to the word.

challengeIntro.calm-breath.text: When feelings get big, small things help. Pick something that calms you.

challengeIntro.empathy-pick.text: Imagine a friend feels sad. What's a kind thing to do?
challengeIntro.empathy-pick.simple: What would a kind friend do?

bloomTier.1.text: Look, a flower is waking up!

bloomTier.3.text: The whole place is singing again. You made this happen.

success.text: Nicely done. You got a new spark in your pocket.

gentleError.text: Not quite — try again whenever you're ready.
